text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (I've always been chasing the back running ahead of me.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (I'll pass—that back!!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond crosses the finish line in the lead!!
With diamond-hard resilience, she shattered her rivals!
(WOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Aaaagh! So frustratinggg!
I loooostttt!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Still, this is sooooo much fuuuun!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! Me too!
I had sooooo much fun too!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: We get to experience this fun over and over from now on!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Congrats, Diamond-chan!
You looked so cool out there!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
That was an incredible race!!
You ran brilliantly, Satono-!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's waiting for you, Dia-chan!
Come on, you have to go!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond-san,
congratulations!
Could you tell us how you feel right now?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I am so happy to finish out the Classic year with such a magnificent race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: This past year... I have pushed forward with the Classic Triple Crown as my goal, but the journey was by no means an easy one.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: A great many things occurred, some of which were entirely unforeseen.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: What kind of incident happened, specifically?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The bad weather during the Satsuki Sho, for instance...
It turned out to be far stormier than expected.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Races in the Twinkle Series sometimes feel
quite difficult... But today was truly a wonderful race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "My heartfelt thanks to everyone who ran alongside me as well. Thank you very much."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank you too!
Next time I won't lose, Dia-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, looking great, Kitasan!
I'll be rooting for you next time too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Do your best too, Diamond-chan!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
You two are childhood friends who have openly
declared yourselves rivals for a long time now!
Have you decided on your next showdown yet?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: No, not yet...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The Osaka Hai!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm running in the Osaka Hai!
Payback for this year!!
(Ooooohhh!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Which means it's the Spring Senior Triple Crown!
Let's go take it, Kitasan!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes! Everyone, please watch me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm running too! In the Osaka Hai!!

"We haven't discussed the next race yet,
nor even our overall plan for the Senior Year."

However, after a quick glance my way,
Satono Diamond turned back to the stands
and repeated herself once more.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna take on Kita-chan at the Osaka Hai!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond versus Kitasan Black—
will this rivalry showdown continue?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is just the beginning...
Ooooh! I'm gonna see this rivalry through to the very end!!

The roar of the crowd engulfs the stands, showing no sign of calming down.
Just then, Kitasan Black calls all the participating Umamusume over to the winner's circle.
The Umamusume lined up in a row and looked up at the stands. Then, they raised both hands and waved them wide from side to side.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, please keep supporting us
next year too!!
(WOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...I apologize for taking matters into my own hands.

The moment she returned to the waiting room,
Satono Diamond bowed deeply.
choice_data_list: Is the Osaka Hai really the right choice for our next goal?
Is the Osaka Hai okay for our next goal?

text_block_list.text:
There are no issues with the distance or timing.
Just to be safe, I needed to make sure the decision
aligned with her plan to become a legendary Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. The Osaka Hai is a GⅠ race, so there is no problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Watching Kita-chan in the winner's circle today... made me realize once again just how amazing she is.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I won the race, but I still
haven't truly caught up to Kita-chan...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You saw it too, didn't you, Trainer?
The smiles on the faces in the stands.
The earth-shaking cheers.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
With her running, Kita-chan brings joy to everyone
and livens up the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I felt that this was one form of a "great Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I still cannot clearly see
what the ideal form of a "great Umamusume" should be.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
In Kita-chan's case, I believe she has an aura
that makes people naturally want to cheer on her running.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "Kita-chan's running is what captivates the fans and draws them all in."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...In my position as the young lady of the Satono family,
I doubt I could ever spark such fervent passion.

An unwavering strength of will.
She is one who is always noble, never revealing a trace of weakness.

Which makes it all the more frustrating that her efforts go unnoticed.
She shines with a supreme radiance that easily rivals Kitasan Black's.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm happy to hear that... but I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I intend to find
my own way of being a "Great Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: How I, as Satono Diamond, can contribute to the Umamusume world...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
By watching how Kita-chan carries herself,
and continuing to chase after her back...
I feel like I'll be able to find my own way.
choice_data_list: Got it. Next up is the Osaka Hai!
Got it. Next up is the Osaka Hai!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Trainer,
I look forward to working with you!

The ideal form of a "great Umamusume."
Searching for an answer yet unseen, I shall forge ahead through the Senior Class with Satono Diamond.
